name: Kabondo-Dianda

queries.query: Kabondo-Dianda cadastral parcels Democratic Republic of the Congo official
queries.result: No official Kabondo-Dianda parcel viewer or parcel-vector endpoint found. Results pointed to general DRC cadastral administration and non-cadastral place references.

queries.query: Kabondo-Dianda cadastre parcelles République démocratique du Congo site officiel
queries.result: The official Ministry site, official land-registry consultation service, and official Ministry circonscriptions page were found; no public parcel geometry/API for Kabondo-Dianda was exposed.

registryCustodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la RDC; the official service describes cadastral and real-estate register consultation through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre. A Kabondo-Dianda-specific public local office or open data endpoint was not evidenced.

portalsFound.observation: Official Ministry homepage returned HTTP 200 HTML. It advertises a Projet Pilote de Numérisation du Cadastre focused on management, preservation, security, and digitization of land archives; no public parcel map/vector endpoint was present in the inspected HTML or loaded JavaScript.

Official Ministry page lists 143 land/cadastral jurisdictions across 26 provinces. It is an administrative directory, not a parcel geometry service; Kabondo-Dianda was not listed as a jurisdiction in the retrieved page.
Official land-search workflow accepts property/reference fields for charges, mortgages, or fiscal status. It is a form workflow and not an anonymous parcel-vector API.
Official public-service catalog describes paid consultation of cadastral and real-estate registers through the responsible land-registration/cadastre offices. It does not publish parcel geometry.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Official HTML loaded with browser-like headers; viewer/config inspection found Next.js content APIs and a localhost document link, but no WFS, FeatureServer, MapServer, OGC API, or GeoJSON parcel endpoint.
Official content catalog returned document metadata, including the cadastral digitization project; no parcel IDs, geometries, schema, or CRS.
Official homepage content API returned project/news slide metadata only; no parcel records.
Backend WordPress root exposed only standard content namespaces/routes on inspection; no cadastral parcel feature service was identified. This host was not treated as a parcel source.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.error: DNS resolution failed through the request environment
requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Unreachable and not a verdict on national or citywide absence; no TLS exception or bypass attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The Ministry presents a national cadastral administration and a pilot digitization project; the official directory claims 26 provinces and 143 jurisdictions.

No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, DNS failure, or absent public endpoint was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
No parcel polygon, source-specific raw attribute set, native identity, schema, or CRS was obtained or retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, title, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
Packet completion is research completion only, not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The Ministry's cadastral records and digitization program may include Kabondo-Dianda through a local or provincial office, but the current anonymous public map/API URL, parcel schema, stable native identity semantics, CRS, and open coverage were not established.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may recheck official Ministry deployments and any future public cadastral viewer, using a bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry request if one is exposed.
